ttea.controller

Controller classes of the T-TEA platform.

Developed by the Larva UDESC team.

This package provides the controllers that connect the views to the services of the T-TEA platform.

Attributes

__version__str

The current version of the package.

__date__str

The release date of this version.

__author__str

The development team.

__license__str

The license under which the package is distributed.

InstitutionFacilityListController

ProfessionalEditController

ProfessionalListController

List window of professionals.

Notes

This package is maintained by the Larva UDESC team and is under active development. Contributions and bug reports are welcome at: https://github.com/larvattea/ttea

Modules

automaticcalibrationcontroller

Controller of the automatic calibration with a ChArUco board.

maincontroller
